turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have eighteen minutes before a call, Hale. Owen's zero went into the gradebook and he found out on his phone, in the middle of class. Withdraw it, and tell me who decided that.
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
"Spoke with the vice principal." That's not an answer to who decided. Was that before the zero went in or after, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.
"Policy is policy." Then let's read yours: 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. You still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
"A courtesy." I'm writing that down, along with the fact that 4.2 puts the meeting before the zero, not a week after it. Withdraw the zero, Hale, or I'm going upstairs.
